reason: файлы содержали утверждения о 651 неучтённых действиях и 5790/5803 выборах вне группы максимума, полученные неуникальным join по (turn, player); Stage 4.1.1 seq-join показал 0 таких случаев — утверждения отозваны. score_precision_audit.json/report were themselves superseded (Stage 4.1.3 audit reused pre-seq-join chosen_hex_id sidecars, duplicated decisions, and counted singleton maximums as equal-impact ties; the Stage 4.1.4 regeneration used arm-specific '<3.5'/'overflow' labels that inferred base clamp/overflow membership from the final score). In Stage 4.1.6 they have been regenerated from the original trace.jsonl files with neutral final-score buckets (final_max<3.5 / ==3.5 / >3.5, identical for both arms), every recorded tie marked precision-uncertain, and the score_field_semantics block documenting A0 base clamp → penalties/faction bonuses → final mod_score and A1 base overflow transform → penalties/faction bonuses → final mod_score (verified run: 960 traces, join problems=0, A0 13925 / A1 13607 selected corrupt_hex, tie groups 1676/909, correctable 266/1). They are no longer superseded.
